info.name: MassLauncher for Pump.fun — read-only API quickstart
info.description: Three account reads. None of these requests submits a launch, spends credits, or moves SOL. In Postman desktop, add your key to your local Vault as masslauncher_api_key and restrict its allowed domain to masslauncher.fun. Do not paste a key in this file or share your responses. [Setup and expected results](https://masslauncher.fun/blog/pump-fun-api-postman?utm_source=postman&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=masslauncher_api&utm_content=collection).

request.description: A 200 with zero credits is a successful authentication check.
Read the coins array. An empty array is valid.
Read the jobs array for this account. No job is created by this GET.
